caseName: Little Sisters of the Poor Home for the Aged v. Burwell
caseNameFull: LITTLE SISTERS OF THE POOR HOME FOR THE AGED, DENVER, COLORADO v. Sylvia BURWELL, Secretary of Health and Human Services

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit granted limited to Questions 1 and 2 presented by the petition. The case is consolidated.
